prompt: Make a four-key animation study of this EXACT Coral Claw crab. A 2 by 2 grid, FOUR separate full-body sprites, equal cell sizes, generous transparent gutters. No text or grid lines. Camera stays FRONT in every cell, same body scale, same carapace center and ground height. Crab SCUTTLES SIDEWAYS toward image RIGHT while looking at viewer, in-place walk cycle, not forward walking. Eight walking legs, FOUR per side, plus two claw arms. Number walking legs mentally 1(frontmost) to4(rearmost) on each body side. Alternate support groups: group A right1/right3/left2/left4; group B right2/right4/left1/left3. Top left: group A planted supporting shell, group B knees bent feet slightly lifted and reaching toward image right. Top right: group B makes contact to right, group A pushes ground toward left. Bottom left: group B planted supporting shell, group A knees bent feet slightly lifted and reaching right. Bottom right: group A contacts to right, group B pushes ground left. Fixed rigid leg segment lengths, articulation at knees and ankles only; never stretch or multiply legs. Retain eight distinct pointed tips, allow natural overlap of roots. Carapace, coral branches, eye stalks and both relaxed closed claws must remain rigid identical across cells, no breathing inflation or changing coral silhouettes. Large anatomical right claw on image LEFT in ALL frames. Do not mirror. Keep frontal torso level, tiny vertical bounce only. Exact ornate wet teal cream and gold armor and pink orange coral from reference, hand-painted fantasy. Full creature visible per cell with ample transparent margin, no shadows, floor, letters, numbering or captions. Transparent background.
